metadata.question: Does the vegetation coverage in the Inner Niger Delta increase in November 2022 compared to May 2022?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Inner Niger Delta (approximately 5°N, 4°W in Mali) - Time periods: May 2022 vs November 2022 - Collection: Sentinel-2 for vegetation (NDVI), with Landsat 8/9 as fallback 2. Masking strategy: - Yes, mask clouds since we're measuring vegetation, not clouds - Use QA60 band for Sentinel-2 cloud masking 3. Logic: - Calculate mean NDVI for both periods - Valid NDVI range: -1 to 1 (typical vegetation: 0.2-0.8) - Compare November vs May NDVI - If November > May, answer A (Yes) - If November <= May, answer B (No) - Handle C1 (no data), C2 (no valid pixels), C3 (invalid calculation) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define geometry for Inner Niger Delta (Mali) const innerNigerDelta = ee.Geometry.Point([4.0, 14.5]).buffer(50000); // 2. Define time periods const may2022Start = '2022-05-01'; const may2022End = '2022-05-31'; const nov2022Start = '2022-11-01'; const nov2022End = '2022-11-30'; // 3. Cloud masking function for Sentinel-2 function maskS2clouds(image) { const qa = image.select('QA60'); const cloudBitMask = 1 << 10; const cirrusBitMask = 1 << 11; const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBitMask).eq(0) .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBitMask).eq(0)); return image.updateMask(mask); } // 4. Function to calculate NDVI function addNDVI(image) { const ndvi = image.normalizedDifference(['B8', 'B4']).rename('NDVI'); return image.addBands(ndvi); } // 5. Get Sentinel-2 data for May 2022 let mayCol = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterDate(may2022Start, may2022End) .filterBounds(innerNigerDelta) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 80)) .map(maskS2clouds) .map(addNDVI); const maySize = mayCol.size().getInfo(); console.log(`May 2022 Images: ${maySize}`); if (maySize === 0) { console.log('No Sentinel-2 data for May 2022, trying Landsat 8...'); mayCol = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterDate(may2022Start, may2022End) .filterBounds(innerNigerDelta) .map(function(image) { const ndvi = image.normalizedDifference(['SR_B5', 'SR_B4']).rename('NDVI'); return image.addBands(ndvi); }); const mayLandsatSize = mayCol.size().getInfo(); console.log(`May 2022 Landsat Images: ${mayLandsatSize}`); if (mayLandsatSize === 0) { console.log('No data available for May 2022.'); console.log('C1'); return; } } // 6. Get Sentinel-2 data for November 2022 let novCol = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterDate(nov2022Start, nov2022End) .filterBounds(innerNigerDelta) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 80)) .map(maskS2clouds) .map(addNDVI); const novSize = novCol.size().getInfo(); console.log(`November 2022 Images: ${novSize}`); if (novSize === 0) { console.log('No Sentinel-2 data for November 2022, trying Landsat 8...'); novCol = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterDate(nov2022Start, nov2022End) .filterBounds(innerNigerDelta) .map(function(image) { const ndvi = image.normalizedDifference(['SR_B5', 'SR_B4']).rename('NDVI'); return image.addBands(ndvi); }); const novLandsatSize = novCol.size().getInfo(); console.log(`November 2022 Landsat Images: ${novLandsatSize}`); if (novLandsatSize === 0) { console.log('No data available for November 2022.'); console.log('C1'); return; } } // 7. Calculate mean NDVI for both periods const mayNDVI = mayCol.select('NDVI').median(); const novNDVI = novCol.select('NDVI').median(); // 8. Reduce to get mean values with pixel count const mayStats = mayNDVI.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: innerNigerDelta, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const novStats = novNDVI.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: innerNigerDelta, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const mayMean = mayStats['NDVI_mean']; const mayCount = mayStats['NDVI_count']; const novMean = novStats['NDVI_mean']; const novCount = novStats['NDVI_count']; console.log(`May 2022: NDVI=${mayMean}, Pixels=${mayCount}`); console.log(`Nov 2022: NDVI=${novMean}, Pixels=${novCount}`); // 9. Validation checks if (mayCount === 0 || novCount === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after masking.'); console.log('C2'); return; } if (mayMean === null || mayMean === undefined || novMean === null || novMean === undefined) { console.log('Calculation failed (null/undefined result).'); console.log('C3'); return; } if (mayMean < -1 || mayMean > 1 || novMean < -1 || novMean > 1) { console.log('Invalid NDVI values (out of range).'); console.log('C3'); return; } // 10. Final comparison console.log(`Vegetation change: ${((novMean - mayMean) * 100).toFixed(2)}%`); if (novMean > mayMean) { console.log('Vegetation coverage increased in November 2022.'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('Vegetation coverage did not increase in November 2022.'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
